dimensions.assessment: Affects commercial banks seeking mergers or business combinations and federal regulators processing those applications.
dimensions.evidence: relates to the review of applications under the Bank Merger Act

dimensions.assessment: Changes the regulatory procedures and application requirements for bank mergers, affecting administrative burdens for financial institutions.
dimensions.evidence: revises procedures for reviewing applications for proposed bank mergers, such as by removing automatic approvals under an expedited review procedure

dimensions.assessment: No direct federal spending or revenue effects are stated or implied.
Uses the Congressional Review Act to entirely nullify an agency's final rule and regulatory framework.
dimensions.evidence: Congress disapproves the rule submitted by the Office of the Comptroller of the Currency... and such rule shall have no force or effect.

dimensions.assessment: Permanently voids the specified rule, preventing it from taking effect or having any force.
dimensions.evidence: such rule shall have no force or effect.

missing_information: The specific number of future bank merger applications that would utilize the prior versus the nullified procedures is not specified.
importance_detail.rationale: The joint resolution nullifies the Office of the Comptroller of the Currency's final rule on business combinations under the Bank Merger Act, eliminating revised review procedures such as the removal of automatic approvals and streamlined forms.
